_comment: Apify accepts NONE of this through actor.json, the CLI or the API -- verified against
This file is the repo-side source of truth for what a human types into
Apify Console -> Development -> My Actors -> fediverse-scraper -> Publishing.
The event names below MUST match src/sink.js exactly: charging an event the Console
does not know about returns an error and the run loses its billing.
seoTitle: Mastodon & Bluesky Scraper - Profiles, Posts, Hashtags (Fediverse)
seoDescription: Scrape Mastodon and Bluesky profiles, posts and hashtags via official public APIs. One normalized schema, no login, pay only for what you extract.

events.eventDescription: One account profile with follower, following and post counts, bio and avatar.
One post or boost with text, engagement counts, media, hashtags and mentions.
